messages:
liz: FYI console lint started surfacing a bunch of false positives for routing configs that our CI accepts. short repro below.
kevin: can you paste a tiny example?
liz: here — CI passes but console flags "unknown-annotation" and "anchor-order":
```
# team: billing
match:
  path: /v1/invoices/*
  headers:
    - name: x-org-id
      pattern: '^[0-9]{1,10}$'
route:
  backend: invoices-canary
  weight: 100
# console-skip=anchor-order
```
liz: people are using `# console-skip` comments to suppress editor lint only. CI validation ignores comments so tests are green.
rob: does console parse comments into metadata? that's what it looks like.
kevin: yeah console currently treats any top-level `# key: val` or `# foobar=` as potential metadata then validates it against a small console schema. that is brittle.
nana: options: (A) teach console to only accept a reserved object key like `x_console:` and ignore arbitrary comments, or (B) continue comment-annotations but extend the parser/schema to accept more keys.
liz: short-term I propose we stop treating comments as metadata. make `# console-...` purely ignored by parser. long-term: introduce a reserved `x_console` top-level object with strict shape (lint, ui, display) so editor controls are explicit.
kevin: +1. but note some runtime parsers (esp on Dedicated/private) currently reject unknown top-level keys. if we add `x_console` we must ensure either the runtime ignores unknown keys or we namespace under `x_runtime` that's explicitly allowed.
rob: runtime change is risky. I'd rather keep runtime untouched: console should look for `x_console` only when present and never treat comments as metadata. runtime continues to reject unknown keys — customers who run stricter validation will have to opt-in to `x_console` via their parser, we can provide a shim.
nana: add three test vectors to config-fuzz: (1) inline `# console-skip` comments, (2) `x_console: { lint: { suppress: ["anchor-order"] } }`, (3) top-level unknown key to ensure CI vs console behavior is explicit.
kevin: RFC sketch for `x_console` shape: `lint: { suppress: [rule-id], level: "warn|deny" }`, `ui: { collapsed: bool, notes: string }`, `meta: { owner: string }`. keep it small.
liz: I'll open a tiny patch that changes comment handling in the console parser to ignore `# console-` prefixes and not register them as metadata. will include unit tests.
rob: i'll review. also add a migration note for Dedicated customers and a simple transform script that converts `# console-skip=foo` into `x_console` for repos that want to standardize.
console-bot: preflight: https://ci.internal/redwood/configs/2098765432 — current console-lint false positives: 9, schema errors: 0.
kevin: timeline: comment-parse fix (hotfix), then RFC + `x_console` rollout + migration tool (2 weeks).
nana: I'll add fuzz cases and a CI gate to prevent comments being interpreted as metadata in future.
liz: assigning PR to @rob for review. dropping examples here if anyone hits other false-positives.
rob: noted. thanks all.
